title: 5 day workout program
author: Yasmine Garcia
desc: ** 5 Day Program** is a comprehensive 6-week training plan designed to elevate your fitness game. With workouts scheduled 5 days a week, each session targets specific muscle groups through a mix of strength training and functional movements. Expect to engage in exercises like Pull-Ups, Med Ball Slams, and Sled Pushes, ensuring a balanced approach to building strength and endurance. This program is perfect for anyone looking to challenge themselves and achieve noticeable results in their fitness journey. Get ready to push your limits and transform your body!

ex.note: Make sure to engage your core. You should not feel this in your lower back, but you will fill it in your legs, core and mid back.
Start with the lighter weight for the first set. Roll towards your belly button and squeeze your mid back as your elbows are tucked at your side.
2 sets on each arm. Do this slow slowly and controlled while pausing at the top.
These reps are supposed to completely destroy your glutes, so go hard.
Do as many push-ups as you can if you need to finish the reps on your knees, that’s OK. Keep trying to progress by starting out with regular push-ups off of your knees.
Increase weight with each set
If you do the standing, make sure you are standing with your feet shoulder with the part and engage your core.
You can use any machine that moves in a pressing motion. You want to feel this in your chest not your shoulders.
As for a long band from the front desk or the personal training desk. They thicker the band, the more resistance, a.k.a. the more help you will have. You can also use the assistant pull-up machine.
Each time you find the ball is one rep. I suggest using a 10 pound med ball. These are the smaller black balls on the shelves near the mats. Don’t be scared to throw them hard. They do not bounce.
Push the sled down the turf then you’re going to pull it as you’re walking backwards to get it back to the other side of the turf where you started. This will be considered one rep.

ss.note: Please increase the time during your planks as 30 seconds gets easier. For example, move up to 45 seconds or one minute.

ex.note: Ask the PT desk or the front desk for a short band with medium resistance you can put it around your lower thigh or around your ankle.
You may substitute with: v-squat, smith machine squats, or the belt squat.
Focus on leaning slightly forward as you go down that way you feel more of a stretch in your glutes
If the doctor machine is not available, do wide sumo squats with your torso upright in your toes pointed out. Descend slow, pause at the bottom, and then push the floor away from you.
You’ll need an attachment for this. Do the 15 reps extremely slowly.
